source: offline causal replay of seven command-enriched paired clips

changes.S1: Use issued TCP displacement, measured TCP displacement and force rise before confirming a new boundary. A slow command that the TCP follows remains S1.
changes.S2: When opposed tools already have grip evidence, cross-check the support plane with the TCP face estimate when the RGB height rejects it.
changes.S3: Evaluate partial support transfer before the high-load suspended-tool shortcut.
changes.S0: Separate tool release from the 25 mm parking retreat. A signed face gap of at least 5 mm plus 50 ms of low force can mark release. The 25 mm value remains the parking-complete flag.
changes.S5_S6: Confirm each boundary independently. Retain a previously witnessed neighbor only after a rear-wall witness and require transverse force or torque before upgrading to S6.

limitations: The A numbers use the existing paired A run. The attempted fresh visual A startup did not produce a runner report.
The generic S5/S6 observer still misses an independent U4 back04 S6 segment because the side witness was not established in that run.
All results are offline replay. The revised observer is not yet in closed-loop task control.
